name: ragcode
description: Semantic code intelligence using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Supports Go, PHP, Python, JavaScript/HTML. Provides semantic search, call hierarchies, usage finding, and automatic IDE configuration. Compatible with Windsurf, Cursor, Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI, Zed, and VS Code + GitHub Copilot.

stdio.description: Standard input/output (default, used by IDEs with command: config)

http.description: Streamable HTTP stateless transport. Start with --http-port 3000. Configure IDEs with url: http://localhost:3000/mcp

ollama.description: Local LLM for embeddings. Required model: qwen3-embedding:0.6b (or any mxbai-embed-large compatible)

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Intelligent code search that automatically determines the best strategy (semantic + exact). Returns full source code for high-confidence matches, compact summaries for exploratory results.

tools.name: rag_search_code
tools.description: Comprehensive code search with explicit mode control: 'discovery' (semantic/conceptual) or 'exact' (hybrid BM25 + vector). Supports graph context expansion — auto-fetches related definitions.

tools.name: rag_find_usages
tools.description: Find where a specific class, function, or type is used across the codebase using the Code Graph (AST relations). Returns exact code chunks, files, and line numbers.

tools.name: rag_call_hierarchy
tools.description: Explore recursive call relationships for a symbol. Supports 'incoming' (who calls this) and 'outgoing' (what this calls) directions, up to a configurable depth.

tools.name: rag_list_package_exports
tools.description: List all public functions, classes, and types in a package/module. Returns structured list with symbol names, types, and signatures. Works for Go packages, PHP namespaces, Python modules.

tools.name: rag_read_file_context
tools.description: Read specific lines from a file with surrounding smart AST context. Requires an exact file path and line number.

tools.name: rag_index_workspace
tools.description: Indexes or reindexes a workspace for semantic code search. Instead of abstract paths, you MUST explicitly provide the absolute 'workspace_root' directory. The tool first validates the root and returns early. Then, you submit a second call with 'confirm': true to actually lock-in the registry root and start the background indexing.

tools.name: rag_list_skills
tools.description: Lists all available embedded AI skills and their installation status in the current workspace.

tools.name: rag_install_skill
tools.description: Installs or uninstalls a specific AI skill into the current workspace. Action must be 'install' or 'uninstall'.

tools.name: rag_evaluate
tools.description: Request a performance and quality evaluation of RagCode MCP from the AI assistant's perspective.

tools.name: rag_check_update
tools.description: Checks for available ragcode-mcp updates on GitHub and reports if a newer version is available.

tools.name: rag_apply_update
tools.description: Downloads and installs the latest version of ragcode-mcp. The server will need to be restarted after completion.

--http-port.description: Port for Streamable HTTP server (POST /mcp). Set to -1 to disable.
